# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** About 11 when first introduced; roughly 13 or 14 during early Queen's preparation.  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c26 P15](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0015), [v1 c28 P8](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0008)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v3 c29 P11](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope, Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with rosy cheeks, dimples like little dents in cream, and glossy black hair and eyes inherited from her mother. She shares her father's merry expression. Though she considers herself short and stout, her appearance is lively and bright.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c33 P12](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0012), [v1 c33 P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013), [v1 c33 P14](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0014)_

## Personality

Diana is a cheerful, affectionate, and good-natured girl who laughs readily before speaking. She is polite, sensible, and deeply faithful to her friendships. Though less imaginative than Anne Shirley, she is an enthusiastic companion who enjoys reading, fun, and romance.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027), [v1 c12 P30](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0030), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v2 c26 P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060), [v3 c12 P20](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0020)_

- Affectionate and loyal  <sub>[v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v2 c26 P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060)</sub>

- Sensible and polite  <sub>[v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P30](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0030), [v1 c16 P12](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0012)</sub>

## Abilities

- Singing  <sub>[v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040)</sub>

## Goals

- To be an eternal, faithful bosom friend to Anne Shirley  <sub>[v1 c12 P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036), [v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v2 c26 P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060)</sub>

## History

Diana Barry meets Anne Shirley when Anne moves to Green Gables, and the two immediately swear an oath of eternal friendship. Shortly after, during a tea party at Green Gables, Diana accidentally becomes drunk when Anne unknowingly serves her currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, causing Mrs. Barry to strictly forbid them from seeing each other. Diana secretly keeps in touch until she falls gravely ill with croup during a night her parents are away; Anne nurses Diana's little sister Minnie May through the night, winning Mrs. Barry's forgiveness and restoring their friendship. Together, the two create playhouses, form a story club, and go on trips, including an exciting visit to Charlottetown hosted by Diana's wealthy aunt, Miss Josephine Barry. Unlike Anne, Diana does not attend Queen's Academy because her parents choose not to send her. She later becomes engaged to Fred Wright, whom she marries, eventually settling into domestic life and giving birth to her firstborn child.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036), [v1 c16 P28](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0028), [v1 c16 P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 c16 P45](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0045), [v1 c16 P59](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0059), [v1 c17 P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 c17 P28](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0028), [v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 c18 P19](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0019), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c26 P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023), [v1 c29 P15](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0015), [v1 c29 P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 c29 P12](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0012), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c29 P10](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0010), [v3 c29 P11](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0011), [v3 c39 P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041)_

## Background by volume

- Named by a schoolmaster who boarded with her parents when she was born  <sub>[v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064)</sub>
- Grew up at Orchard Slope with no sisters near her age  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)</sub>
- Encouraged by her father to read despite her mother's strictness  <sub>[v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)</sub>

## Quotes

> Why, I guess so. I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with. There isn’t any other girl who lives near enough to play with, and I’ve no sisters big enough.  <sub>[v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)</sub>

> Why it’s dreadfully wicked to swear.  <sub>[v1 c12 P30](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0030)</sub>

> You’re a queer girl, Anne. I heard before that you were queer. But I believe I’m going to like you real well.  <sub>[v1 c12 P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037)</sub>

> I’m—I’m awful sick. I—I—must go right home.  <sub>[v1 c16 P29](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0029)</sub>

> Diana Wright will, though. There, mother’s calling. Come.  <sub>[v3 c29 P11](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0011)</sub>
